title: The late twenties
name: The late twenties
body:
Technology: Phones and early care robots.

Climate: Hotter summers, smoke seasons.

Economy: Tight housing.

Politics: Polarized and loud.

Daily life: Long commutes and remote work.

title: The thirties
name: The thirties
body:
Technology: Home robots become ordinary.

Climate: Floods on the Columbia.

Economy: Recovery after a slump.

Politics: Trade talks across the Pacific.

Daily life: Families split across time zones.

title: The forties
name: The forties
body:
Technology: Grid batteries everywhere.

Climate: Seawalls under construction.

Economy: Steady growth.

Politics: A new trade accord holds.

Daily life: Video calls feel like rooms.

title: The fifties
name: The fifties
body:
Technology: Translation earpieces are free.

Climate: Delta seawall finished.

Economy: Automation layoffs.

Politics: Visa lottery reopens.

Daily life: More people work from home than not.

title: The sixties
name: The sixties
body:
Technology: Robots do most deliveries.

Climate: Wildfire smoke returns.

Economy: Basic income pilots.

Politics: Regional blocs strengthen.

Daily life: Shorter work weeks.

title: The seventies
name: The seventies
body:
Technology: Household robots outnumber cars.

Climate: Cooler wet years.

Economy: Slow growth.

Politics: Calm.

Daily life: Grandparents live with grandchildren again.

title: The eighties
name: The eighties
body:
Technology: Coastal transit lines.

Climate: Sea level up half a meter.

Economy: Service economy.

Politics: Quiet.

Daily life: Neighborhood gardens.

title: The last decade
name: The last decade
body:
Technology: Ambient computing.

Climate: No Arctic summer ice.

Economy: Uncertain.

Politics: Climate treaties.

Daily life: People talk about the old coastline.
